raw:
The user wants me to write UI strings for a mobile app in Traditional Chinese (Taiwan usage). The screen is a list page where pulling down refreshes data from the backend.

Strings needed:
- s1: hint text when pulling down (pull-to-refresh hint)
- s2: status text after refresh completed
- s3: text when list is empty

Taiwan UI conventions:
- Pull to refresh: 「下拉即可重新整理」or「下拉以更新」— Common iOS wording in Traditional Chinese (Taiwan): "持續下拉以重新整理" / "下拉以重新整理". After release: "放開以重新整理" / "放開來立即更新" / "放開以更新". Loading: "更新中..." or "正在更新…". Completed: "更新完成" / "最後更新時間...".

Avoid mainland terms: 刷新 (mainland usage; Taiwan uses 重新整理 or 更新), 加载 (Taiwan uses 載入), 数据 (Taiwan uses 資料), 信息, 网络, app usage etc.

s1: hint while pulling down — 「下拉即可重新整理」or「持續下拉以重新整理」. Since it's the hint when pulling down, maybe 「下拉以重新整理」works.

s2: status after fetching completed — 「更新完成」. Or 「已更新至最新資料」/「資料已更新」.

s3: list empty — 「目前沒有任何項目」or「尚無資料」. Taiwan UI often uses 「目前沒有資料」「尚无内容」... Taiwan: 「沒有任何項目」. Could be 「清單目前沒有項目」or「目前尚無任何項目」.

Only output a JSON object with keys s1, s2, s3, no other text.

Let me finalize:
- s1: "下拉即可重新整理"
- s2: "資料已更新"
- s3: "目前沒有任何項目"

JSON:
{"s1": "下拉即可重新整理", "s2": "資料已更新", "s3": "目前沒有任何項目"}{"s1": "下拉即可重新整理", "s2": "資料已更新", "s3": "目前沒有任何項目"}
